seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The newly formed party takes odd jobs as couriers and investigators in Hallia, gradually uncovering a conspiracy involving Ugathul skinwalkers, the Roundhat Gang's radar dishes, and the necromancer Master Grayson — culminating in a raid on Grayson's underground Fane and a narrow escape with damning evidence.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A catastrophic ambush at the Crowded Flea leaves three party members dead, sending Johnny and Benny through the void of the Black and White to be restored by the entity Aut. Reunited and reinforced by Sir Arctos, the party takes revenge on Hlarf, assaults Tywelwyn Leatherhide in his fiery Fane, and discovers six Thessian gods attempting to crack the Firmament.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: Rescuing Anaïs reveals the cosmic family called the Narrative, and the party attends a massive pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost to compete for keystones granting passage aboard a colossal Strider. Through gladiatorial trials, puzzle-solving, diplomacy with a Prime Meridian Heart, and a bloody ambush by Concordia enforcers, the party secures their keystone and prepares for the voidward journey.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During a six-month downtime, the party investigates the sewers beneath Teller's Run and discovers a fracture in reality itself — a window into a parallel world where a two-mile-tall deity stands imprisoned behind the Firmament. After hacking a research terminal to uncover a vast conspiracy and bombing the facility, they escape as Teller's Run collapses in ash.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Aboard the colossal Strider, the party builds a Fane with their newborn heart Eerie, navigates deadly faction politics under a devilish Master of Ceremonies who demands weekly tithes of life energy, and delves deep into the Undercroft to ally with the ancient Machine God and purge the Herald's cultists — until a catastrophic ritual to recruit the Menhir destroys that cosmic sibling and flings the Strider to a dead, scoured world far off every map.

seasons.title: Stranded
seasons.arc_summary: Stranded on a godless horizon, the party rallies surviving factions, frees a half-minotaur gunslinger from the Herald's compulsion via psychic mind-dives, battles corrupted Harlequins in the Strider's spire, defeats Anzu's sister Galzu inside Tally's Fane, and ventures across the wastes to explore the abandoned Hesperid mining outposts — making first contact with alien castaways who reveal the Ashen Pact's newly ascended Thessians.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Joker World Descent
seasons.arc_summary: The Scale operatives — Sir Cliff, Gregor, the Reverend, and Zangren Lee — are dispatched to a shattered Joker World to investigate a slip-shielded structure, battling through demon swarms and solving the Quorum's fiendish puzzles before descending through a bloodfall portal to rescue Voice of Many, a trapped divine heart, and escape back to headquarters. (The season also opens with the conclusion of a prior Cagley Middle one-shot.)

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Sedecium agents Scrazzy, Foral, and Ozzie investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunk in the slip, uncovering that the Thessian Gremory ('Esoterica') tortured the station's AI and accessed records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core. The season establishes the team, their handler TuRiin, and the central mystery driving the campaign.

seasons.title: One Last Job
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement, the fire team boards a Sundom planet-killer to raid divine essence from the freshly-slain Thessian god Tithe before the God Eater Harrow finishes consuming it. The one-shot heist shifts tone to a high-stakes extraction mission, proving the team's elite capability as the first and only fire team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
